records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Zara,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Harbor Works!
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Your workspace for Harbor Works is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:b624605a, email:2a3733ef) despite a held welcome call (calendar:6ecde6a8); internal note asking for context (slack:b4509e9c) signals no known champion momentum. 8 days left but no observed activity makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Harbor Works project
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week. Since then your Harbor Works workspace has been quiet, so I wanted to check in before the week gets away from us.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. One real project is usually all it takes for the rest to click.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Nadia
